notes:
What's new in 0.1.114:
- Library update emails and the bell can list the names of the files that were added, the folder, who added them and when Beebo first saw them. A new Settings checkbox chooses whether file names are included.
- Movies: the sidebar counts agree with the library, and preparing a film for streaming uses the same file the library shows when a film and its converted copy share a name.
- Photos recovers when a folder you chose before is missing. Picture Frame keeps keyboard focus and removes pictures you no longer have access to.
- Routine video conversions wait while you are watching, then start again.
- Movie Night keeps keyboard focus and tells you when a save fails. Settings shows a Retry button if loading fails and keeps what you typed.
- Remote Desktop: each approval only counts for its own request. The browser Appearance page and viewing privacy errors are translated.
- The new library email texts are translated into German, Spanish, French, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese; these translations have not been read by a native speaker yet.
- Automated tests and code review only; not yet tried on a real second PC or device by a person.
- Release source commit 14146fd3d.
- Built: Nov 8, 2026, 1:55 PM Eastern.
- Published: Nov 8, 2026, 2:56 PM Eastern.
